title: Wire harness orientation

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The drawing says the green wire goes in the left slot, but the sample on my bench has it on the right.
turns.zh: 圖面寫綠線放左邊的插槽，但我工作檯上的樣品是放右邊。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The drawing shows the plug from the side where the wires go in. You're looking into the end that plugs into the board. Turn the sample around; the green wire should be on your left now.
turns.zh: 圖面是從進線那一面看插頭。你現在看的是插進電路板的那一端。把樣品轉過來，綠線現在應該在你左邊。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Yes, it is. We still need a photo for the assembly guide. The photo we took yesterday was from the board end, just like my first view.
turns.zh: 對，確實在左邊。我們還需要一張組裝指南的照片。昨天拍的是插板端，跟我剛才一開始看的方向一樣。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Keep yesterday's photo for the final inspection page. That's the end inspectors can see once the harness is in place. For assembly, take a new photo that shows the same side as the drawing.
turns.zh: 昨天的照片留給最終檢驗那頁。線束裝好後，檢驗人員看得到的是那一端。至於組裝，請重拍一張與圖面同一側的照片。

audioScript:
The drawing says the green wire goes in the left slot, but the sample on my bench has it on the right.
The drawing shows the plug from the side where the wires go in. You're looking into the end that plugs into the board. Turn the sample around; the green wire should be on your left now.
Yes, it is. We still need a photo for the assembly guide. The photo we took yesterday was from the board end, just like my first view.
Keep yesterday's photo for the final inspection page. That's the end inspectors can see once the harness is in place. For assembly, take a new photo that shows the same side as the drawing.
